name: flatrate/flarum-media-privacy
description: FlatRate.wiki FoF Upload privacy guard: opaque basenames and fail-closed image metadata stripping.

suggest.fof/upload: Target integration is FoF Upload 1.9.0; the privacy listener is inert when FoF Upload is absent or disabled.
suggest.ext-gd: Required on the Flarum host for JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF metadata stripping.
suggest.ext-exif: Required on the Flarum host to apply JPEG orientation before EXIF is discarded.
suggest.ext-imagick: Optional; required only to accept HEIC/HEIF uploads instead of rejecting them.
